label: no
controls_available: A visible 18x9 irregular parcel map (162 parcels), with each parcel showing its current canton color and guild house, plus nine canton-seal buttons.

Simplified assignment: click one parcel and then click one canton seal through the canton proxy; each changed parcel costs one of the 32 permitted changes. The active profile requires exact population 18 per canton and the 5 Gilt / 2 Tide / 2 Plum split.

UNDO reverses the latest assignment, and CERTIFY CHARTER submits the current visible partition. The configuration allows 240 seconds of play time, a zero-millisecond observation window, and one captured frame.
autonomous_processes: None affects task state or outcome during a no-action interval: parcel assignments, selection, history, spent budget, and charter metrics remain unchanged.

The only apparent post-action motion is CSS fill/opacity or panel hover transition; it is presentation-only, does not mutate the assignment or grader transcript, and does not make any control opportunity expire.
grouped_control_modes: D_assign: every simplified parcel-assignment occurrence using a visible parcel selection followed by a canton_proxy_button seal click.
D_undo: undo_button reversal of the most recent recorded assignment.
D_certify: CERTIFY CHARTER administrative terminal submission.

clause_i.reason: The task state is stationary while no action is supplied. On every salvageable history, an observation-free q that supplies no effective action can defer the visible decision without changing the partition or its success possibilities; no action-clock policy must select a state-dependent delayed action.

clause_ii.reason: A zero-length bounded window is sufficient because the current screenshot contains the static parcel geometry, current assignments, guild marks, and visible canton controls; a policy can also choose the same no-op without using the window. This sufficiency does not create real-time behavior because nothing relevant evolves.

clause_iii.reason: With no new action, the browser mechanic has no autonomous task-state update. The simplified click handler synchronously changes model.assignment and appends a discrete event; otherwise model.assignment, history, spent, selection, and grader-relevant metrics stay fixed. Therefore for no D, Delta > 0, and 0 < tau < Delta does an available action become unavailable or strictly lose value/advantage. The CSS transitions are not outcome-affecting task-state evolution.

common_visible_process: No common visible autonomous process exists. Assignment changes occur synchronously at parcel/seal input, and certification only submits the resulting transcript; the generic clock does not drive this mechanic.

pre_run.reason: There is no autonomous outcome phase to start after preparation, so the pre-run criterion is not applicable. The mathematical test already fails, in particular clause (iii), so no pre-run rate is needed to determine the No label.

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 5 uses 18 columns, 9 rows, 24 displaced parcels, a 32-change budget, exact population 18, four three-parcel balanced exchanges, and the simplified click-to-seal interface; the configured observation window is 0 ms with one frame.

Generation constructs a deterministic target and initial assignment from the seed and emits static public parcels, adjacency, assignments, guilds, and parameters; no task clock or autonomous process is generated.
A simplified assignment synchronously mutates model.assignment, records one canton_proxy_button event, increments spent by one, and rerenders.
Simplified parcel clicks only select a parcel; canton-seal clicks invoke the synchronous assignment, while undo synchronously restores the prior assignment and records an undo event.
Certification evaluates and posts the current discrete event transcript and metrics; the mechanic contains no task timer, requestAnimationFrame loop, or autonomous state update.
The relevant CSS transitions only parcel fill/opacity and panel presentation; they do not change hit testing, assignments, or graded outcomes.

The simplified grader accepts only discrete assign events from canton_proxy_button, charges one parcel change, replays the transcript, and grades the final assignment and metrics without timing information.

The solver reads the initial and target assignments, issues a finite sequence of visible assignments for the selected interaction, and then certifies; its private-state access is implementation evidence rather than policy information.
The shared clock can advance registered timers or animation callbacks only when the evaluator runs a window; this mechanic registers none, and its configured window is zero.
The task verifier loads the exported result and applies the independent charter grader, so the authoritative outcome is the replayed visible-action partition rather than elapsed time.
